args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 but was
actually using ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test failures in
tests/test_money.py. Switch the quantize rounding mode to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py`'s `round_money` claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 but was actually using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failures in `tests/test_money.py`.
- Switched the `quantize` rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 as the tests expect.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch (commit 08d3cd5986) passed.

Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py`'s `round_money` docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212, but it actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which made `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` fail (e.g., 2.665 rounding to 2.67 instead of 2.66).
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` and changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **CI:** Triggered CI run `ci-0001` on the fix commit (08d3cd5986) — it **passed**.
- **PR:** Opened [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` with review requested from **alex**. Merging will still need code-owner approval per policy.
